readback.liquid_pressure_dependence: H(T, 1.5 P_r) - H(T, P_r) == 0 exactly for a liquid stream

common.other_attributes: the tool's defaults, recorded per run

registered.rungs_source: MultiStageEquilibrium.default_algorithms and default_methods (biosteam/units/stage.py:2185-2200), one algorithm per rung, in that order
solve_path: P1 build: MultiStageEquilibrium(ins=inlets, outs=['vapor', 'liquid'] (+ ['distillate'] for a total condenser), N_stages=N, feed_stages=[s-1], P=[P]*N, phases=('g','l'), stage_specifications={...}, [bottom_side_draws={0: 1/(1+RR)}], maxiter=500, max_attempts=1, use_cache=True); then algorithms=(rung,), methods=(method,), early_termination=False, tolerance=relative_tolerance=1e-10

P3 re-store every registered native specification through the stage's attribute setter (Reflux r: stage.B = 1/r, or inf for r = 0, or 0 for r = inf; Boilup b: stage.B = b; Duty q: stage.Q = 3.6 q; Flow f: stage.F = f; Temperature t: stage.T = t); never specify_variables
P4 simulate()  (pass 2); the record is pass 2

native_specifications.bottoms_rate: stage N-1: ('Flow', B / sum of the registered inlet flows)
native_specifications.duty: the end stage: ('Duty', 3.6 Q) in kJ/h
native_specifications.temperature_end_stage: the end stage that carries the slot: ('Temperature', T)
not_native: temperature on a stage other than the end stage that carries the slot

outer_loop.residual: g(x) = (s(x) - s*)/|s*| for a relative kind, s(x) - s* for an absolute kind, with s computed from the tool's record by S03 §5.1 row 9 and §17.4
outer_loop.expansion: if g(1) g(2) > 0: x = 4, 8, 16, 32 when |g(2)| <= |g(1)|, else 0.5, 0.25, 0.125, 0.0625; the first sign change against the previous point gives the bracket
outer_loop.solver: flexsolve.IQ_interpolation(g, a, b, g(a), g(b), None, 0.0, ytol, (), 50, False, True, True)
outer_loop.evaluation: every g(x) is a fresh build and the full solve path P1-P4 at the rung's settings, and its state must pass rule 2 (BioSTEAM) and rule 2c's pressure and read-back checks, or the attempt fails
outer_loop.record: one final fresh evaluation at the returned x; |g| <= ytol or the attempt fails

floor_rerun.L2(c): one fresh evaluation (P1-P4) at the selected run's final x, the same binary64 value; no outer loop and no ytol (S09 §18.4)

rows: rule 2c total-condenser vapour / 3.1e-8 mol/s (total condenser only)
rule 2d specification residual / its kind's threshold
rule 2d path spread / 0.1 tolerance (two or more passing rungs)
margin.not_rows: the outer loop's |g|/ytol (set by its own stopping test), exact and structural checks, and rule 2c's 1e-4 definition check (rule 2d's row covers it)
margin.effect: a disclosure listed in comparison.json; it moves no classification (S09 §2.3 step 4; §18.4)

rule2.iteration_cap: no pass's counter reaches maxiter: the tool's iter on R1, R2 and R4; on R3 fsolve's infodict nfev of that pass (fsolve's maxfev is the tool's maxiter), and a pass in which fsolve did not run fails (S09 §18.3)
